clips.title: The story
paras: In Northshire Valley, a novice human warlock is sent to recover a forbidden tome and prove their skill. Drusilla La Salle hopes to claim Powers of the Void from the Defias, whose camp lies in the vineyards.

Warlocks in Stormwind's lands hide their craft and keep prying eyes from their research. Northshire Abbey guards forbidden grimoires in its archives. Drusilla La Salle, the warlock mentor on the abbey grounds, covets Powers of the Void but cannot risk suspicion from the clerics and paladins by entering the library's protected wing herself.

An abbey novice joins the Defias Brotherhood and steals several valuable texts on his way out. He flees to the Northshire Vineyards and takes refuge around the Defias campsite. The thieves stash their prize in a field tent, unaware of the danger in the book's dark arts.

Recovering the tome tests a novice warlock's nerve and opens the way to darker knowledge. Braving the bandit camp and returning the text satisfies Drusilla's ambition and proves the pupil is ready. She rewards the pupil with the dark rites to summon and bind an imp, the first demon an apprentice learns to command.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I hope you're sure about becoming an adventurer, because if you can't hold your own, you're likely to get pulled under.
I'm to teach you, but I need to make sure you're strong enough first.
There was a novice studying at the Abbey who ran off to join the Defias Brotherhood. Why do I care? Well, he stole some important books.
One of those happens to be a book I've wanted for myself, the Powers of the Void. Steal it for me, they have it hidden at their tent in the Vineyards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It was too conspicuous for me to steal the book myself. What luck one of their own patsies did the dirty work for me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent... I was never able to gain access to this text, it was held in a protected wing of the library that would have looked suspicious for me to be loitering around.
Well, you did a good job in getting this, and I'm convinced that you can probably handle your own imp, so there's no reason for me not to show you how to summon one.
